move: city bars rise centre-out with overshoot under a sun, drop away
how: A night-gradient stage with a blurred orange sun and ten tall bars (alternating blue gradients, a dotted window pattern via ::after) standing on a thin ground line like a skyline. Title, subtitle and total counter slide up y:20 (power3.out, stagger 0.1) and the sun rises from y:180/opacity:0 (power2.out, 1.4s) from frame 0; the ground line scales scaleX from 0 (expo.out). From 9% the bars rise with scaleY 0 to 1 using back.out(1.6) so they overshoot and settle, staggered 0.07 outward from the centre; city labels and value counters follow with the same centre-out stagger, each value counting to its number with power3.out, while the total counts to 6,980 (power2.out) over 12-52%. Hold: the sun keeps drifting y:-30 on sine.inOut. Exit at 79%: bars collapse scaleY to 0 with expo.in staggered from the edges inward, labels fade, then title/stat/ground/sun fade out.
adapt: Edit the data array of [label, height%] pairs (any count) and the title/subtitle/total; change the bar gradients in .b and .bar:nth-child(odd) .b and the sun colours; keep back.out(1.6) with the from:'center' stagger for the rise and from:'edges' for the collapse.
port: mount(el, shot) builds sun/title/stat/ground and generates .bar elements from shot.data; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with the rise at 0.09-0.5 of D and collapse at 0.79. Counter tweens are object tweens with onUpdate; getElementById for #tot and #bars must be scoped to el.
caveats: value counters are timed by distance from centre (Math.abs(i-4.5)) which assumes ten bars
sun and title fade to nothing at the end, close to the first frame but the sun starts lower
